$Comment: The feast's celebration, the moment a player collects The Feast's pay: a big banner with a fanfare
for them and for everyone within RadiusBlocks of them (the rest of the table), and a firework over
their head. The loot table Harvest_Feast_Feast_Pay names this moment with the Cue on its first roll,
and only The Feast pays that table, so it plays once a year per player.
Reword the banner with the keys notify.harvest_feast_feast_served and its .sub line in
harvestfeast.progression.lang; the sub line's {0} is the player's name. SoundEventId is any
SoundEvent id, heard by each player shown the banner. Command runs as the console with {player}
filled in: the game's own particle spawn command, at that player, with any ParticleSystem id (the
game's Firework_Mix3 and Firework_Mix4 burst in other colours). Delete Command for no firework.
